translations.web: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for Yahweh has spoken this word.
translations.bsb: The earth will be utterly laid waste and thoroughly plundered. For the LORD has spoken this word.
translations.kjv: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled: for the LORD hath spoken this word.
translations.asv: The earth shall be utterly emptied, and utterly laid waste; for Jehovah hath spoken this word.
